stations.title: The API
stations.text: Still reads every workshop from memory.
stations.note: The file sits beside it, unread.

captions: On the sign-up page, Ivo asks for the Thursday workshops, the way he always has.
The answer still comes from memory, while the studio's database file sits unread.
You write the list, one workshop by its id and the filters as queries on the file.
The Thursday workshops come back from kilnworth.db, picked by the database.
Every read comes from the file now, with the visitor's values kept out of the SQL.
